calls:
mkdir -p '/tmp/wsp-run'
u=$(umask)
umask 077
b=/tmp/wsp-run/abababababab
mkdir "$b.d" 2>/dev/null || { echo WSP_LAUNCHED; exit 0; }
set -o pipefail
printf %s 'ZWNobyBpdCdz' | base64 -d > '/tmp/wsp-run/abababababab.sh' || exit 1
setsid nohup bash -c '( umask "$1"; exec bash "$0.sh" ) > "$0.out" 2> "$0.err" < /dev/null; echo $? > "$0.exit"' "$b" "$u" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$b.pid"
echo WSP_LAUNCHED

b=/tmp/wsp-run/abababababab
echo WSP_POLL
printf '%s\n' "$(cat "$b.exit" 2>/dev/null)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +1 "$b.out" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +1 "$b.err" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
p=$(cat "$b.pid" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ] && kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo up; else echo down; fi
echo WSP_POLL_END

b=/tmp/wsp-run/abababababab
echo WSP_POLL
printf '%s\n' "$(cat "$b.exit" 2>/dev/null)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +3 "$b.out" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +1 "$b.err" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
p=$(cat "$b.pid" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ] && kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo up; else echo down; fi
echo WSP_POLL_END
killCalls:
mkdir -p '/r'
u=$(umask)
umask 077
b=/r/abababababab
mkdir "$b.d" 2>/dev/null || { echo WSP_LAUNCHED; exit 0; }
set -o pipefail
printf %s 'c2xlZXAgOQ==' | base64 -d > '/r/abababababab.sh' || exit 1
setsid nohup bash -c '( umask "$1"; exec bash "$0.sh" ) > "$0.out" 2> "$0.err" < /dev/null; echo $? > "$0.exit"' "$b" "$u" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$b.pid"
echo WSP_LAUNCHED
b=/r/abababababab; p=$(cat "$b.pid" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ]; then kill -TERM -- "-$p" "$p" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; kill -KILL -- "-$p" "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi; true

b=/r/abababababab
echo WSP_POLL
printf '%s\n' "$(cat "$b.exit" 2>/dev/null)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +1 "$b.out" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
printf '%s\n' "$(tail -c +1 "$b.err" 2>/dev/null | head -c 262144 | base64 -w0)"
p=$(cat "$b.pid" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ] && kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo up; else echo down; fi
echo WSP_POLL_END
